summary_en: 10,000,000 shares (1.44% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired over 2026/08/05–2026/10/30. Upper limit ¥15.0B. Method: open-market purchase (ToSTNeT-3). Reason: enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Pertaining to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: The Chiba Bank announced on 4 August 2026 that its board of directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 10,000,000 ordinary shares of treasury stock, representing 1.44% of shares outstanding (691,264,388 shares ex-treasury as of 31 July 2026). The acquisition is capped at ¥15.0 billion and will be executed over the period 5 August 2026 to 30 October 2026 via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (ToSTNeT-3). The stated purpose is to enhance capital efficiency and thereby improve the return of profits to shareholders.
